text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

I won the race... But unable to stay put, 
I ran out onto the turf. During the race, 
I noticed something was slightly off with 
the pacing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah... I did it, Trainer-sama~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I apologize, though. Somehow, I feel a 
bit, well, today..."
choice_data_list:
She was rushing the pace a bit, wasn't 
she?

She seemed a bit rushed out there, didn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. I've never felt so rushed or 
panicked before. Why is that, I wonder...?

The usually laid-back Mejiro Bright was 
feeling impatient about the race. That 
showed just how much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It was... a very important race. And yet, 
Trainer... I managed to, somehow—

"Spring has come. Not just to the foot of 
Mount Yotei, —but right here, too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Grandmother, Bright is...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But it shouldn't come as a surprise. 
I did tell you back at the Make Debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"That the next Umamusume to win the 'Tenno 
Sho (Spring)' will be this girl."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—!? Just from watching that slow-paced 
race...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Splendidly done, Bright. With this, you 
are now my rightful successor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Our bond has deepened quite a lot, hasn't 
it? It feels unreal to think we were once 
so distant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Lady McQueen... I shall carry out my 
duties with utmost dedication. And 
someday—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I dream of it, you know~ Running alongside 
you in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... It's kind of bittersweet, I 
guess. She used to be glued to my side all 
the time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course, my feelings for Ryan-onesama 
haven't changed one bit~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, being surrounded by so many 
people, I...

Mejiro Bright was now, indisputably, one 
of the central pillars of the prestigious 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"So, Trainer-san, what shall we do for our 
next race?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the real challenge starts from here. 
Whether Bright's strength can still hold 
up in an era of pure speed. To prove that, 
which race should we...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I don't particularly have any hopes~. 
But~, there is one wish of mine that will 
never, ever change..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in the races that are 
important to Mejiro. Without fail.

An important race for the Mejiros, and one 
that also demands speed.

There is one race that comes to mind 
immediately. The inevitable intersection 
of both factors.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"The Tenno Sho (Autumn)... So that's the 
one, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I was absolutely certain of that as well, 
you know~"

Having conquered the Tenno Sho (Spring), a 
Spring-Autumn Double is naturally in 
sight. And then—

A major race where horse girls boasting 
new-era speed will undoubtedly tune 
themselves to perfection. It was the 
perfect stage to showcase the strength of 
the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well then, regarding the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), I'll be in your care~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"So, um~ Trainer, there is one thing that 
has been on my mind..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Everyone talks endlessly about speed, but 
who is truly the fastest right now...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And who might you be, I wonder~?

There are plenty of fast Umamusume. Yet, 
like a comet, an Umamusume who completely 
defied all common sense suddenly appeared.

It was—an Umamusume Mejiro Bright knew 
very well. Yet her running had undergone a 
terrifying transformation.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—I won't turn back anymore. I'll never 
look behind me, never again. And—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I won't give it up. From start to finish, 
this view from the lead is mine!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka with an overwhelming 
victory! A massive-margin front-running 
win in a GII race!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"That makes it four straight wins! With 
her awakened, otherworldly front-running, 
she heads straight for the Takarazuka 
Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-saaan, No waaay... That's so 
cruuuel...

text_block_list.name: All of the Mejiro Family
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooooh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, Suzuka-sama...

In the Mejiro family's party room. 
Everyone watching the broadcast of that 
run froze in shock.

"The Umamusume currently regarded as the 
fastest. It was Silence Suzuka, who walked 
the Classic Road alongside her."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright, I'm... running. In the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dober...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We can't let Bright shoulder it all on her 
own. We promised, didn't we? That we'd do 
our best together for the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what Bright will do, but I'm 
running. Even if I lose, it'll be a good 
reference, and besides—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Of course I want to win! Because I'm a 
Mejiro Umamusume, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober... What a wonderful spirit you 
have~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-sama. If you do not mind, 
might I also accompany Dober—
choice_data_list:
The Takarazuka Kinen, huh. Let me think 
about it.

The Takarazuka Kinen, huh. I'll think 
about it, okay?

text_block_list.text:
Our ultimate target is the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). However, the Takarazuka Kinen 
will also be an important race for gauging 
our future prospects.
